responsibility: Implements GCC’s UndefinedBehaviorSanitizer instrumentation and metadata generation, creating the type descriptors, static data objects, value encodings, diagnostics payloads, and runtime calls needed to check undefined-behavior conditions in GIMPLE. This file owns the pass that inserts checks for signed-integer overflow, null and alignment violations, invalid bool/enum loads, nonnull argument and return contracts, object-size violations, pointer overflow, selected builtins, and related trap-or-recover control flow, and it also provides the shared expansion helpers used later by sanopt for UBSan internal functions such as null, bounds, object-size, pointer, and vptr checks.
same_name_distinction: Implementation companion to gcc/ubsan.h: this source file implements the UBSan pass, check insertion, type-descriptor/data-object construction, value encoding, and internal-function expansion helpers. Unlike the header, it does not merely declare UBSan enums and cross-file APIs for use by other GCC sanitizer code.
